mode.description: Octal permissions on the source file or top-level directory only

hints.octal: Three or four octal digits; for example 0700 or 0750

owner.description: Ownership of the persistent host source, using image accounts or numeric IDs

user.description: Source owner; resolve names in the container image

hints.user: Image user name or numeric UID; for example redis or 1000

group.description: Source group; resolve names in the container image

hints.group: Image group name or numeric GID; for example redis or 1000

recursive.description: Apply configured ownership to directory contents without following symlinks
